title: SMS Consent
body:
SMS Consent Disclosure:**
 By providing your mobile number and checking the SMS consent box on our forms, you agree to receive text messages from Fulvio Correa Plastic Surgery related to your inquiry, consultation, scheduling, patient support, and requested information. Consent is not a condition of purchase.

## 1. Program Name

 **Fulvio Correa Plastic Surgery Patient Communications Program**

## 2. Sender

 Messages are sent by or on behalf of Fulvio Correa Plastic Surgery, located in Cartagena de Indias, Colombia.

 **Messaging number:** +1 650-665-6265.
 Messages only — we do not take calls on this number.

## 3. What Messages You May Receive

- Responses to surgery inquiries and consultation requests

- Appointment scheduling, reminders, and confirmations

- Travel, recovery, and coordination information

- Patient support and administrative communication

- Occasional updates related to your inquiry or care journey

## 4. Message Frequency

 Message frequency varies depending on your interaction with our team and the status of your inquiry or patient coordination process.

## 5. Cost

 Message and data rates may apply depending on your mobile carrier and service plan.

## 6. Consent Is Not Required to Purchase

 Your consent to receive SMS messages is not a condition of purchasing any service, booking a consultation, or receiving medical care.

## 7. How to Opt Out

 You can opt out of SMS messages at any time by replying **STOP**.

 After sending STOP, you will no longer receive SMS messages unless you opt in again.

## 8. How to Get Help

 Reply **HELP** for assistance or contact our patient support team directly.

## 9. Privacy of SMS Consent Data

 **
 We do not sell, rent, or share SMS opt-in data or consent information with third parties for marketing purposes.
 **

 Information related to your SMS consent may only be shared with providers that help us deliver communications, operate our CRM systems, or comply with legal and carrier requirements.

## 10. Eligibility

 You must be the account holder or have authorization from the account holder to provide the mobile number used for messaging communications.

## 11. Supported Carriers

 Message delivery depends on your mobile carrier and network availability. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

## 12. Recommended Form Consent Language

 **Checkbox label:**

 I agree to receive SMS text messages from Fulvio Correa Plastic Surgery about my inquiry, consultation, appointment coordination, and patient support. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to cancel, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. I agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions.

## 13. Recommended Initial SMS Example

 Hi, this is Fulvio Correa Plastic Surgery. Thank you for contacting us about your surgery inquiry. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help. Message and data rates may apply.

## 14. Contact

 For questions regarding SMS consent or messaging communications, contact our patient support team directly.
